summary: Source manifest cannot represent entry route with empty page_url
details: Fresh Kitchen source manifest set page_url to an empty string for the presell entry route. source-html-manifest/v0 rejects empty page_url when present, so prepare-build fell back to filesystem matching and lost explicit commerce shim mappings. Removed the empty page_url as workaround; schema/docs should specify entry-route representation.

summary: Source intake copy missed landing js assets
details: The preserved FreshPak landing referenced /landing/js/jquery-3.6.0.min.js, bookmarkscroll.js, jquery.scroller.js, jquery.accordion.js, and slick.js. The initial copied source-html contained css/images/video only, so doctor flagged built_output.script_missing until the js directory was copied from designer into source-html and page-kit assets.

summary: Doctor keeps static Olympus contract reminders after rendered replacements verify clean
details: After the Fresh build, rendered _site checkout contains only credit/apple-pay/google-pay rows and rooted runtime meta tags, and source frontmatter uses Fresh package/shipping refs. Doctor still emits spec.store_profile.payment_methods_default_on, routing_meta.runtime_root, and frontmatter.demoOnlyValues/replaceFromSpecOrApi reminders because those checks appear tied to CampaignSpec literals or the template contract rather than resolved built/source evidence. This forces agents to re-prove warnings manually.

summary: Bundle pricing presentation needs an explicit surface policy
details: FreshPak checkout cloned the Olympus bundle selector and carried every available pricing permutation into a live campaign: compare-at unit price, current unit price, total compare-at, total current, discount badge, explicit savings, and free-shipping copy. Templates should remain rich, but Campaigns OS needs a deterministic pricing presentation policy or tiny prompt so live campaigns select the few relevant surfaces and strip the rest before build/polish.

summary: Order bump compare-at price should disappear without an applied offer
details: FreshPak checkout bump displayed the same amount as struck compare-at price and current price because no Offer/voucher governs a bump discount. Campaigns OS should either bind bump compare-at to explicit CampaignSpec/API discount evidence or strip the compare-at surface by default for full-price bumps.

summary: Exit-intent template should be stripped or warned when no behavior is configured
details: The Olympus checkout template includes exit-intent scaffolding, but the FreshPak assembly has no CampaignSpec exit_intent behavior, no connected coupon/offer, and no designed modal content. Campaigns OS should strip the include by default or emit a clear warning/blocker when a template exit pop remains unbound.

summary: Manual polish iterations are not captured as new Run Telemetry
details: The second FreshPak review/polish pass materially improved the funnel and surfaced pricing, bump, and exit-intent learnings, but it happened through direct source edits and npm build rather than an active Campaigns OS run session. The local Run Record did not capture a new iteration until findings were added manually; polish-only loops need a lightweight telemetry path or explicit run-session guidance.

summary: Full-document passthrough pages can miss shared campaign CSS injection
details: FreshPak landing.html carried frontmatter css/freshpak-funnel.css, but because it is a complete HTML document using landing-passthrough.html, the shared polish stylesheet was not loaded until added as an explicit link. Workflow should crawl source/built asset paths and verify declared shared CSS is actually loaded before browser QA.
